  ret { i32, ptr } { i32 14, ptr undef }

merge:                                            ; preds = %entry

define { i32 } @heap_CAllocator_free_void_p(ptr %0, { i32, ptr } %1) {
entry:
  %alloc = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %0, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %alloc1 = alloca { i32, ptr }, align 8
  store { i32, ptr } %1, ptr %alloc1, align 8
  %alloc2 = alloca ptr, align 8
  %taint_gep = getelementptr inbounds nuw { i32, ptr }, ptr %alloc1, i32 0, i32 0
  %load = load i32, ptr %taint_gep, align 4
  %taint_gep3 = getelementptr inbounds nuw { i32, ptr }, ptr %alloc1, i32 0, i32 1
  %load4 = load ptr, ptr %taint_gep3, align 8
  store ptr %load4, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  %eq = icmp eq i32 %load, 0
  br i1 %eq, label %untaint_merge, label %untaint_merge

untaint_merge:                                    ; preds = %entry, %entry
  %alloc5 = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 0, ptr %alloc5, align 4
  %load6 = load ptr, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  call void @free(ptr %load6)
  ret { i32 } zeroinitializer
}

  store i64 %0, ptr %alloc, align 4
  %load = load i64, ptr %alloc, align 4
  %call = call { i32, ptr } @heap_CAllocator_malloc_i64(ptr @default_allocator, i64 %load)
  ret { i32, ptr } %call
}

define void @heap_free_void_p({ i32, ptr } %0) {
entry:
  %alloc = alloca { i32, ptr }, align 8
  store { i32, ptr } %0, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %load = load { i32, ptr }, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %call = call { i32 } @heap_CAllocator_free_void_p(ptr @default_allocator, { i32, ptr } %load)
  ret void
}

define void @heap.ArenaBlock(ptr %0, ptr %1, i64 %2, i64 %3, ptr %4) {
entry:
  %struct_gep = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %0, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %1, ptr %struct_gep, align 8
  %struct_gep1 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %0, i32 0, i32 1
  store i64 %2, ptr %struct_gep1, align 4
  %struct_gep2 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %0, i32 0, i32 2
  store i64 %3, ptr %struct_gep2, align 4
  %struct_gep3 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %0, i32 0, i32 3
  store ptr %4, ptr %struct_gep3, align 8
  ret void
}

define { i32, ptr } @heap_ArenaAllocator_malloc_i64(ptr %0, i64 %1) {
entry:
  %alloc = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %0, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %alloc1 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 %1, ptr %alloc1, align 4
  %load = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %load2 = load i64, ptr %alloc1, align 4
  %call = call { i32, ptr } @heap_ArenaAllocator_malloc_aligned_i64_i64(ptr %load, i64 %load2, i64 8)
  ret { i32, ptr } %call
}

define { i32, ptr } @heap_ArenaAllocator_malloc_aligned_i64_i64(ptr %0, i64 %1, i64 %2) {
entry:
  %alloc = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %0, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %alloc1 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 %1, ptr %alloc1, align 4
  %alloc2 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 %2, ptr %alloc2, align 4
  %load = load i64, ptr %alloc1, align 4
  %lt = icmp slt i64 %load, 0
  %load3 = load i64, ptr %alloc2, align 4
  %gt = icmp sgt i64 %load3, 0
  %not = xor i1 %gt, true
  %add = add i1 %lt, %not
  br i1 %add, label %then, label %merge

then:                                             ; preds = %entry
  ret { i32, ptr } zeroinitializer

merge:                                            ; preds = %entry
  %load4 = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %struct_gep = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %load4, i32 0, i32 0
  %load5 = load ptr, ptr %struct_gep, align 8
  %eq = icmp eq ptr %load5, null
  br i1 %eq, label %then_2, label %merge_2

then_2:                                           ; preds = %merge
  %load6 = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %load7 = load i64, ptr %alloc1, align 4
  %load8 = load i64, ptr %alloc2, align 4
  %call = call { i32, ptr } @heap_ArenaAllocator_new_block_and_malloc_i64_i64(ptr %load6, i64 %load7, i64 %load8)
  ret { i32, ptr } %call

merge_2:                                          ; preds = %merge
  %load9 = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %struct_gep10 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %load9, i32 0, i32 0
  %load11 = load ptr, ptr %struct_gep10, align 8
  %struct_gep12 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load11, i32 0, i32 2
  %load13 = load i64, ptr %struct_gep12, align 4
  %alloc14 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 %load13, ptr %alloc14, align 4
  %load15 = load i64, ptr %alloc14, align 4
  %load16 = load i64, ptr %alloc2, align 4
  %div_cmp = icmp eq i64 %load16, 0
  br i1 %div_cmp, label %div_zero, label %div_ok

then_3:                                           ; preds = %div_ok
  %load21 = load i64, ptr %alloc14, align 4
  %load22 = load i64, ptr %alloc2, align 4
  %load23 = load i64, ptr %alloc17, align 4
  %sub = sub i64 %load22, %load23
  %add24 = add i64 %load21, %sub
  store i64 %add24, ptr %alloc14, align 4
  br label %merge_3

merge_3:                                          ; preds = %then_3, %div_ok
  %load25 = load i64, ptr %alloc14, align 4
  %load26 = load i64, ptr %alloc1, align 4
  %add27 = add i64 %load25, %load26
  %alloc28 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 %add27, ptr %alloc28, align 4
  %load29 = load i64, ptr %alloc28, align 4
  %load30 = load i64, ptr %alloc14, align 4
  %lt31 = icmp slt i64 %load29, %load30
  %load32 = load i64, ptr %alloc28, align 4
  %load33 = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %struct_gep34 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %load33, i32 0, i32 0
  %load35 = load ptr, ptr %struct_gep34, align 8
  %struct_gep36 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load35, i32 0, i32 1
  %load37 = load i64, ptr %struct_gep36, align 4
  %gt38 = icmp sgt i64 %load32, %load37
  %add39 = add i1 %lt31, %gt38
  br i1 %add39, label %then_4, label %merge_4

then_4:                                           ; preds = %merge_3
  %load40 = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %load41 = load i64, ptr %alloc1, align 4
  %load42 = load i64, ptr %alloc2, align 4
  %call43 = call { i32, ptr } @heap_ArenaAllocator_new_block_and_malloc_i64_i64(ptr %load40, i64 %load41, i64 %load42)
  ret { i32, ptr } %call43

merge_4:                                          ; preds = %merge_3
  %load44 = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %struct_gep45 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %load44, i32 0, i32 0
  %load46 = load ptr, ptr %struct_gep45, align 8
  %struct_gep47 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load46, i32 0, i32 0
  %load48 = load ptr, ptr %struct_gep47, align 8
  %alloc49 = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %load48, ptr %alloc49, align 8
  %load50 = load ptr, ptr %alloc49, align 8
  %load51 = load i64, ptr %alloc14, align 4
  %ptr2int = ptrtoint ptr %load50 to i64
  %ptr_add = add i64 %ptr2int, %load51
  %int2ptr = inttoptr i64 %ptr_add to ptr
  %alloc52 = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %int2ptr, ptr %alloc52, align 8
  %load53 = load i64, ptr %alloc28, align 4
  %load54 = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %struct_gep55 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %load54, i32 0, i32 0
  %load56 = load ptr, ptr %struct_gep55, align 8
  %struct_gep57 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load56, i32 0, i32 2
  store i64 %load53, ptr %struct_gep57, align 4
  %load58 = load ptr, ptr %alloc52, align 8
  %3 = insertvalue { i32, ptr } { i32 0, ptr undef }, ptr %load58, 1
  ret { i32, ptr } %3

div_ok:                                           ; preds = %merge_2
  %mod = srem i64 %load15, %load16
  %alloc17 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 %mod, ptr %alloc17, align 4
  %load18 = load i64, ptr %alloc17, align 4
  %eq19 = icmp eq i64 %load18, 0
  %not20 = xor i1 %eq19, true
  br i1 %not20, label %then_3, label %merge_3

div_zero:                                         ; preds = %merge_2
  %4 = call i32 @puts(ptr @div_zero_msg)
  call void @exit(i32 1)
  unreachable
}

define { i32, ptr } @heap_ArenaAllocator_new_block_and_malloc_i64_i64(ptr %0, i64 %1, i64 %2) {
entry:
  %alloc = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %0, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %alloc1 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 %1, ptr %alloc1, align 4
  %alloc2 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 %2, ptr %alloc2, align 4
  %load = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %struct_gep = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %load, i32 0, i32 1
  %load3 = load i64, ptr %struct_gep, align 4
  %alloc4 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 %load3, ptr %alloc4, align 4
  %load5 = load i64, ptr %alloc1, align 4
  %load6 = load i64, ptr %alloc2, align 4
  %add = add i64 %load5, %load6
  %load7 = load i64, ptr %alloc4, align 4
  %gt = icmp sgt i64 %add, %load7
  br i1 %gt, label %then, label %merge

then:                                             ; preds = %entry
  %load8 = load i64, ptr %alloc1, align 4
  %load9 = load i64, ptr %alloc2, align 4
  %add10 = add i64 %load8, %load9
  store i64 %add10, ptr %alloc4, align 4
  br label %merge

merge:                                            ; preds = %then, %entry
  %call = call { i32, ptr } @heap_CAllocator_malloc_i64(ptr @default_allocator, i64 ptrtoint (ptr getelementptr (%heap.ArenaBlock, ptr null, i32 1) to i64))
  %ext_taint = extractvalue { i32, ptr } %call, 1
  %ins_val = insertvalue { i32, ptr } { i32 0, ptr undef }, ptr %ext_taint, 1
  %alloc11 = alloca { i32, ptr }, align 8
  store { i32, ptr } %ins_val, ptr %alloc11, align 8
  %alloc12 = alloca ptr, align 8
  %taint_gep = getelementptr inbounds nuw { i32, ptr }, ptr %alloc11, i32 0, i32 0
  %load13 = load i32, ptr %taint_gep, align 4
  %taint_gep14 = getelementptr inbounds nuw { i32, ptr }, ptr %alloc11, i32 0, i32 1
  %load15 = load ptr, ptr %taint_gep14, align 8
  store ptr %load15, ptr %alloc12, align 8
  %eq = icmp eq i32 %load13, 0
  br i1 %eq, label %untaint_merge, label %untaint_merge

untaint_merge:                                    ; preds = %merge, %merge
  %load16 = load i64, ptr %alloc4, align 4
  %call17 = call { i32, ptr } @heap_CAllocator_malloc_i64(ptr @default_allocator, i64 %load16)
  %alloc18 = alloca { i32, ptr }, align 8
  store { i32, ptr } %call17, ptr %alloc18, align 8
  %alloc19 = alloca ptr, align 8
  %taint_gep20 = getelementptr inbounds nuw { i32, ptr }, ptr %alloc18, i32 0, i32 0
  %load21 = load i32, ptr %taint_gep20, align 4
  %taint_gep22 = getelementptr inbounds nuw { i32, ptr }, ptr %alloc18, i32 0, i32 1
  %load23 = load ptr, ptr %taint_gep22, align 8
  store ptr %load23, ptr %alloc19, align 8
  %eq24 = icmp eq i32 %load21, 0
  br i1 %eq24, label %untaint_merge_2, label %untaint_merge_2

untaint_merge_2:                                  ; preds = %untaint_merge, %untaint_merge
  %load25 = load ptr, ptr %alloc19, align 8
  %ptr2int = ptrtoint ptr %load25 to i64
  %alloc26 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 %ptr2int, ptr %alloc26, align 4
  %load27 = load i64, ptr %alloc26, align 4
  %load28 = load i64, ptr %alloc2, align 4
  %div_cmp = icmp eq i64 %load28, 0
  br i1 %div_cmp, label %div_zero, label %div_ok

then_2:                                           ; preds = %div_ok
  %load33 = load i64, ptr %alloc2, align 4
  %load34 = load i64, ptr %alloc29, align 4
  %sub = sub i64 %load33, %load34
  store i64 %sub, ptr %alloc30, align 4
  br label %merge_2

merge_2:                                          ; preds = %then_2, %div_ok
  %load35 = load ptr, ptr %alloc19, align 8
  %load36 = load ptr, ptr %alloc12, align 8
  %struct_gep37 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load36, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %load35, ptr %struct_gep37, align 8
  %load38 = load i64, ptr %alloc4, align 4
  %load39 = load ptr, ptr %alloc12, align 8
  %struct_gep40 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load39, i32 0, i32 1
  store i64 %load38, ptr %struct_gep40, align 4
  %load41 = load i64, ptr %alloc30, align 4
  %load42 = load i64, ptr %alloc1, align 4
  %add43 = add i64 %load41, %load42
  %load44 = load ptr, ptr %alloc12, align 8
  %struct_gep45 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load44, i32 0, i32 2
  store i64 %add43, ptr %struct_gep45, align 4
  %load46 = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %struct_gep47 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %load46, i32 0, i32 0
  %load48 = load ptr, ptr %struct_gep47, align 8
  %load49 = load ptr, ptr %alloc12, align 8
  %struct_gep50 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load49, i32 0, i32 3
  store ptr %load48, ptr %struct_gep50, align 8
  %load51 = load ptr, ptr %alloc12, align 8
  %load52 = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %struct_gep53 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %load52, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %load51, ptr %struct_gep53, align 8
  %load54 = load ptr, ptr %alloc19, align 8
  %alloc55 = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %load54, ptr %alloc55, align 8
  %load56 = load ptr, ptr %alloc55, align 8
  %load57 = load i64, ptr %alloc30, align 4
  %ptr2int58 = ptrtoint ptr %load56 to i64
  %ptr_add = add i64 %ptr2int58, %load57
  %int2ptr = inttoptr i64 %ptr_add to ptr
  %3 = insertvalue { i32, ptr } { i32 0, ptr undef }, ptr %int2ptr, 1
  ret { i32, ptr } %3

div_ok:                                           ; preds = %untaint_merge_2
  %mod = srem i64 %load27, %load28
  %alloc29 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 %mod, ptr %alloc29, align 4
  %alloc30 = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 0, ptr %alloc30, align 4
  %load31 = load i64, ptr %alloc29, align 4
  %eq32 = icmp eq i64 %load31, 0
  %not = xor i1 %eq32, true
  br i1 %not, label %then_2, label %merge_2

div_zero:                                         ; preds = %untaint_merge_2
  %4 = call i32 @puts(ptr @div_zero_msg.1)
  call void @exit(i32 1)
  unreachable
}

define { i32 } @heap_ArenaAllocator_free(ptr %0) {
entry:
  %alloc = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %0, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %load = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %struct_gep = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %load, i32 0, i32 0
  %load1 = load ptr, ptr %struct_gep, align 8
  %alloc2 = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %load1, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  br label %while_cond

while_cond:                                       ; preds = %while_body, %entry
  %load3 = load ptr, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  %eq = icmp eq ptr %load3, null
  %not = xor i1 %eq, true
  br i1 %not, label %while_body, label %while_end

while_body:                                       ; preds = %while_cond
  %load4 = load ptr, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  %struct_gep5 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load4, i32 0, i32 3
  %load6 = load ptr, ptr %struct_gep5, align 8
  %alloc7 = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %load6, ptr %alloc7, align 8
  %load8 = load ptr, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  %struct_gep9 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load8, i32 0, i32 0
  %load10 = load ptr, ptr %struct_gep9, align 8
  %wrap_val_arg = insertvalue { i32, ptr } { i32 0, ptr undef }, ptr %load10, 1
  %call = call { i32 } @heap_CAllocator_free_void_p(ptr @default_allocator, { i32, ptr } %wrap_val_arg)
  %load11 = load ptr, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  %wrap_val_arg12 = insertvalue { i32, ptr } { i32 0, ptr undef }, ptr %load11, 1
  %call13 = call { i32 } @heap_CAllocator_free_void_p(ptr @default_allocator, { i32, ptr } %wrap_val_arg12)
  %load14 = load ptr, ptr %alloc7, align 8
  %cast_load = load %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load14, align 8
  store %heap.ArenaBlock %cast_load, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  br label %while_cond

while_end:                                        ; preds = %while_cond
  %load15 = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %struct_gep16 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %load15, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr null, ptr %struct_gep16, align 8
  ret { i32 } zeroinitializer
}

define { i32 } @heap_ArenaAllocator_reset(ptr %0) {
entry:
  %alloc = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %0, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %load = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %struct_gep = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %load, i32 0, i32 0
  %load1 = load ptr, ptr %struct_gep, align 8
  %alloc2 = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %load1, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  br label %while_cond

while_cond:                                       ; preds = %while_body, %entry
  %load3 = load ptr, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  %eq = icmp eq ptr %load3, null
  %not = xor i1 %eq, true
  br i1 %not, label %while_body, label %while_end

while_body:                                       ; preds = %while_cond
  %load4 = load ptr, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  %struct_gep5 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load4, i32 0, i32 2
  store i64 0, ptr %struct_gep5, align 4
  %load6 = load ptr, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  %struct_gep7 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load6, i32 0, i32 3
  %load8 = load ptr, ptr %struct_gep7, align 8
  %cast_load = load %heap.ArenaBlock, ptr %load8, align 8
  store %heap.ArenaBlock %cast_load, ptr %alloc2, align 8
  br label %while_cond

while_end:                                        ; preds = %while_cond
  ret { i32 } zeroinitializer
}

define void @heap.ArenaAllocator(ptr %0, ptr %1, i64 %2) {
entry:
  %struct_gep = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %0, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %1, ptr %struct_gep, align 8
  %struct_gep1 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %heap.ArenaAllocator, ptr %0, i32 0, i32 1
  store i64 %2, ptr %struct_gep1, align 4
  ret void
}

  %struct_gep7 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %wlroots.wl_list, ptr %load6, i32 0, i32 1
  store ptr %load5, ptr %struct_gep7, align 8
  %load8 = load ptr, ptr %alloc1, align 8
  %load9 = load ptr, ptr %alloc, align 8
  %struct_gep10 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %wlroots.wl_list, ptr %load9, i32 0, i32 1
  store ptr %load8, ptr %struct_gep10, align 8
  %load11 = load ptr, ptr %alloc1, align 8

  store ptr %load11, ptr %struct_gep15, align 8
  ret void
}
